summary: Three gauges (CPU 67, Memory 82, Disk 45) that share colour zones for success, warning and error.
use: Resource or SLA dashboards where thresholds change the gauge colour.
spec: `const zones: GaugeZone[]` with 3 entries: `{ until: 0.5, color: 'success' }`, `{ until: 0.8, color: 'warning' }`, `{ until: 1, color: 'error' }`
`const metrics` with 3 items: CPU `67`, Memory `82`, Disk `45`, fields `label` and `value`
`{#each metrics as m}` renders `<GaugeChart value={m.value} {zones} height="200px" />`
Each gauge sits in its own `<Card material="glass">` inside `<Grid class="grid-auto-200" gap="4">`
